text: DSH Team Bots 是面向 DSH Web 的团队协作插件，把一个工作区组织成项目群聊、机器人团队和任务看板。它通过 DSH 工具接口派发、重派和验收任务，并按写入路径范围调度可并行工作；工作台还提供共享记忆与技能审批、运行用量和成本查看，以及可选的个人微信消息通道。适合需要让多个 DSH bot 围绕项目持续协作、跟踪交付并复用团队知识的工作流程。需要 DSH CLI 和 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本；微信通道需单独启用并扫码登录。

DSH Team Bots adds project chats, a bot task board, and shared memory to DSH Web. Its tools dispatch and review tasks; write scopes guide parallel runs. It also offers skill approvals and usage views. Optional WeChat needs setup and QR login. Requires DSH CLI and Node.js 22.19+.
我想把几个 DSH bot 组织成能围绕项目协作的团队。
有没有带任务看板、能把工作派给不同机器人的 DSH 扩展？
让团队机器人按各自要改的文件范围并行处理任务。
想让项目里的机器人共享经过整理的长期记忆。
怎么在一个网页工作台里查看 bot 的群聊和任务进度？
我需要统计不同项目和模型的 token 用量及成本。
希望用微信接收个人 DSH 团队的任务消息。
How can I coordinate several DSH bots with project tasks and shared memory?
I need a web workspace to dispatch work to bots and review their deliveries.
Can parallel bot runs avoid editing the same project files?
任务派发与验收：在项目中创建或重派任务卡，指定 bot、优先级和时间预算，并由负责人接受交付或退回修改。
按写入范围调度：任务声明项目内要修改的路径，调度器可让路径不重叠的任务并行运行。
共享记忆审阅：机器人可沉淀任务经验，记忆条目支持待审、批准、驳回及按团队或项目管理。
用量与成本查看：按项目和全局统计 token 与成本，并允许配置模型价格和预算阈值。
微信消息通道：启用并扫码绑定个人微信后，可通过工作区通道收发团队消息与任务通知。
DSH Team Bots 的微信通道使用腾讯 iLink 服务；启用该通道后，相关微信消息会经该服务收发。 (见 src/wechat/channel.ts:217-225)

dsh-team-bots README · DSH Team Bots：[中文](docs/README.zh.md)

`dsh-team-bots` is a DSH plugin that turns one workspace into a team: project group chats, a task board, write-scope parallel scheduling, shared memory and skills, approval cards, usage and cost, and a personal WeChat channel. Every run keeps its trajectory, duration, token count and cost.

dsh-team-bots README · Requirements：- Node.js ≥ 22.19
- the DSH CLI (`dsh`)

The plugin runs inside the DSH Web process. It has no standalone service and no port of its own.

dsh-team-bots README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-team-bots
```

From a checkout (packs the working tree and installs it into the profile):

```sh
npm run profile:install -- --profile <name>
```

Plugin files inside a profile are a snapshot. After changing code, reinstall — otherwise the page keeps serving the old build.

dsh-team-bots README · Open the workspace：```text
http://<host>:<port>/                     DSH web, auto-login into the team workspace
http://<host>:<port>/api/dsh-team/ui      the team workspace itself
```

The first visit exchanges the current startup token for a 30-day login cookie. Auto-login means anyone who can reach the port becomes owner, so listen on the local machine or a trusted network; for public use put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front that forwards Host and WebSocket correctly.

dsh-team-bots README · Group chats and dispatch：Every project is a group chat. A bot can also be addressed one-to-one in a dispatch view. Session bindings run in four lanes — task, solo, dm, project — so a group chat, a task run and a direct message never block each other.

dsh-team-bots README · Task board：States: backlog, todo, in progress, blocked, in review, done, canceled. A card carries assignee, priority, parent/child links, tags, write scopes, an optional time budget (a hard limit that aborts the run), comments, and its own usage. Rows are grouped by state and can be dragged onto another group to change status.

dsh-team-bots README · Write scopes and parallel scheduling：A card declares the paths it will write, relative to the project working directory. Two runs of the same project run in parallel only when both declare scopes and the path prefixes do not overlap; a card with no declared scope is treated as serial. An urgent card may be exempted from the queue — the exemption is written into the card's creation message rather than applied silently.

dsh-team-bots README · Memory, skills, evolution proposals：Memory entries are written, reviewed, frozen and archived by the owner, and are readable by every bot in the project. Skills come from a shared skill root plus per-project skills; changing them goes through a proposal, an approval and an apply, with a canary stage before promotion to full effect. The same path can change a bot's role instructions.

dsh-team-bots README · Approval and question cards：When a bot asks for a tool approval, a secret, or an answer, the workspace shows a card in the chat. The owner approves, denies or answers in place, and the decision is recorded on the card.

dsh-team-bots README · Usage and cost：The usage page breaks the numbers down by model, bot and project, exports CSV, and reads model prices from configuration. Run limits (timeout abort, no-progress watchdog, review idle threshold) and budgets are set per workspace.

dsh-team-bots README · Terminal, channels, secrets：A per-project terminal runs commands in the project directory. The WeChat channel binds by QR code and pushes task activity to the owner's WeChat. Secrets are scoped to the team or to one project; values are only ever shown as a fingerprint and are handed out as one-time runtime copies that expire.

dsh-team-bots README · Configuration：| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_TEAM_WORKSPACE` | `~/.dsh/workspace/team-bots` | team workspace root |
| `DSH_TEAM_DATA` | `<workspace>/.data` | database and run records |

Every other variable, its default, and its resolution order (explicit env > value saved in the workspace > code default) live in `src/config.ts`; `.env.example` lists the common ones. Do not put a `.env` file in the repository root — it would leak `DSH_*` into `npm test` and `npm run dev`.

dsh-team-bots README · Configuration：`DSH_TEAM_DATA` holds `team.sqlite`, `wechat-channel.sqlite`, `secret.key`, `memory/`, `messages/` and `secrets-runtime/`. Back up `secret.key` together with the data: without it the stored ciphertext cannot be decrypted.

dsh-team-bots README · Develop：```sh
npm install
npm run build       # compile TypeScript into the shipped .js files
npm run typecheck
npm test            # build, then node --test over tests/ and scripts/

Additional harnesses: `npm run backup` / `npm run restore-check` for data, `npm run verify:agent-team` for the agent-team capability, `npm run load-test` and `npm run fault-test` for the runtime.

Repository layout:

dsh-team-bots README · Develop：```text
ui/            the browser workspace (modules, styles, zh/en copy)
src/           HTTP API, database, runtime and domain services
src/services/  domain logic: chat, tasks, scheduler, memory, skills, approvals, usage
src/tools.ts   the tool surface bots see (team_* tools)

dsh-team-bots README · Release：```sh
npm run release            # add --dry-run to print the plan without touching anything
```

The tool pushes `dev`, lands it on `main` (fast-forward when possible, otherwise a content snapshot), pushes `main` and the tag, then syncs `dev` back. Publishing uses npm OIDC trusted publishing — no `NPM_TOKEN` — and the workflow installs npm ≥ 11.5.1 before publishing.
